oil.when: 2012–2018 (no oil change reminder in the trip computer)
oil.note: These model years have no oil change or maintenance reminder to reset. Follow the mileage in your maintenance schedule and check the oil with the dipstick. Checked in the 2012 and 2018 owner's manuals.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light and the CHECK TIRE PRES message do not go out right after you add air; they go out once the system re-reads the tires while driving.
If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2012 and 2018 owner's manuals.
